newsitem.title: USA: Amgen named in whistle blower lawsuit.
newsitem.headline: Amgen named in whistle blower lawsuit.

text.p: Amgen Inc has been named in a lawsuit filed under the "whistle blower" provisions of the Federal False Claims Act, the company disclosed in a filing Wednesday with the Securities and Exchange Commission.

Amgen said in the filing that the suit alleges it violated the False Claims Act as a result of certain sales and reporting practices relating to its products. It said the law requires the government to investigate the allegations and determine whether it wishes to intervene and take responsibility for the lawsuit.
An Amgen spokesman declined to discuss the specific allegations or to disclose any more details, saying the lawsuit was under seal and the company was prohibited from talking about it.
However, it says in the filing that it disputes and will vigorously contest the allegations.
It also said in the filing that in the event of an unfavorable result, the matter "could have a material adverse effect on Amgen's results of operations."
The suit seeks an order that Amgen cease and desist from the improper practices alleged and pay unspecified damages.
